ADLC_TOOLKIT_ROOT="$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT"; [ -n "$ADLC_TOOLKIT_ROOT" ] || [ ! -d "$HOME/.claude/skills/partials" ] || ADLC_TOOLKIT_ROOT="$HOME/.claude/skills"; [ -n "$ADLC_TOOLKIT_ROOT" ] || ADLC_TOOLKIT_ROOT=$(cat "$HOME/.claude/adlc/plugin-root" 2>/dev/null); export ADLC_TOOLKIT_ROOT="${ADLC_TOOLKIT_ROOT:-$HOME/.claude/skills}"
[ -f .adlc/partials/ethos-inject.sh ] || [ -f "$ADLC_TOOLKIT_ROOT/partials/ethos-inject.sh" ] || exit 0
if [ -f .adlc/partials/ethos-inject.sh ]; then . .adlc/partials/ethos-inject.sh; else . "$ADLC_TOOLKIT_ROOT/partials/ethos-inject.sh"; fi
adlc_ethos_inject --harness codex --field session_id=session_id --field cwd=cwd --field transcript_path=transcript_path
